title: Pokemon TCG Korean Wigglytuff ex 040/165 151 Double Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Korean Wigglytuff ex card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. It features a full art design with a holographic finish, making it a highly sought-after addition to your collection. The card is from the Scarlet & Violet - 151 set and has a card number of 40.

This card is a Double Rare with an SV of 151-040/165, making it an extremely unique and valuable card. It is a Stage 1 Pokémon with 250 HP and the Colorless attribute. The card is in standard size and made of high-quality card stock material. It is suitable for ages 4 and up and is manufactured by Nintendo in Korea, Republic of. Add this Wigglytuff ex card to your collection today!
